items.title: Wall Street Is Looking Here. I’m Looking Somewhere Else
items.summary: Everyone is chasing the same AI trade, but one chipmaker sitting in NVIDIA's shadow just posted 50% revenue growth and landed commitments worth gigawatts from two of the biggest names in tech. The real question is whether the valuation leaves any room to be wrong.

items.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Cisco Systems (CSCO) Expanding Sovereign AI Infrastructure In Saudi Arabia
items.summary: In recent days, AMD, Cisco and HUMAIN detailed plans to expand their joint AI infrastructure in Saudi Arabia to as much as 1 GW by 2030, while Cisco also introduced a Sovereign Critical Infrastructure portfolio in Canada for air-gapped, on‑premises deployments across key sectors. Taken together, these moves show Cisco pushing deeper into sovereign AI and critical infrastructure, targeting customers that need high‑performance compute alongside strict data residency and control. items.title: The TPU Mix Is Thinning Broadcom's Gross Margin, Not Its Profit

items.title: Nvidia Looks Like a Growth Stock Again. Why the Chip Maker Is a Bargain.
items.summary: Nvidia  stock is back in fashion.  For evidence the chip maker is once again attracting growth-hungry investors, look no further than ARK Invest’s Cathie Wood.  After its recent blowout earnings, Nvidia should be able to shed fears that it is too big to grow at a rapid rate.
